referenceFunction.includedProcesses:
Electricity mix from wind power in Europe. The mix consists of 87% from onshore wind farms and 13% from offshore wind farms, reflecting a total electrictiy generation of 420 TWh from onshore wind farms and 61.8 TWh from offshore wind farms in 2024 (source: ENTSO-E).
The considered contributions from different wind turbine sizes to the electrcity generation mix are: 50% from onshore wind turbines with nominal capacities < 3 MW (modelled using 2.3 MW onshore wind turbine) 22% from onshore wind turbines with nominal capacities >= 3 MW and < 4 MW (modelled using 3.4 MW onshore wind turbines) 10% from onshore wind turbines with nominal capacities >= 4 MW and < 5.5 MW (modelled with 4.5 MW onshore wind turbines) 5% from onshore wind turbines with nominal capacities >= 5.5 MW (modelled with 6.4 MW onshore wind turbines) 5% from offshore wind turbines with nominal capacities < 7 MW (modelled with 5 MW offshore wind turbines) 7% from offshore wind turbines with nominal capacities >= 7 MW and < 12 MW (modelled with 10 MW offshore wind turbines) 1% from offshore wind turbines with nominal capacities >= 12 MW (modelled with 15 MW offshore wind turbines)
